#+TITLE: 41 dot-emacs check-parens (the plan-41 E.1 real run)
#+STARTUP: overview

* Dev process setup
  Obey .github/copilot-instructions.md (mirrored in CLAUDE.md).  This
  plan runs in /workspace/dot-emacs, dispatched through the room
  `dot-emacs_parens41` (cluster plan 41 E.1).

* Goal [0/1]
  - [ ] G1 `bin/check-parens.sh` exits 0 on the checkout and non-zero,
        naming the file, on an unbalanced .el.

* Phase A — the check [0/1]
  - [ ] A.1 write bin/check-parens.sh (~10 lines): for each argument (default
        `bartuer-*.el`), `emacs --batch -Q` inserts the file, runs
        `emacs-lisp-mode` and `check-parens`, and prints `BAD <file>` on
        error.  Exit 1 if any file is BAD.
        :test_tool: `bin/check-parens.sh; echo rc=$?` gives rc=0.
        `printf '(defun x (' > /tmp/b.el; bin/check-parens.sh /tmp/b.el`
        prints BAD /tmp/b.el with rc=1 (positive control).  Commit, push,
        and done --ref <dot-emacs sha>.
